description: Resolve an informal address, place name or landmark description (including distance hints like 'a school 67 m away, a university 272 m away') to coordinate candidates. Each candidate has name, address, lat, lng, a 0-1 confidence that rises when sources agree, and the source and source_url it came from. Pass near (lat/lng), city or country to bias results. Cost: priced like one search query; no charge when nothing is found.

city.description: City or area name used to bias the search.

near.description: Bias point: candidates closer to it rank higher.

name: alterlab_geocode
title: Geocode Address or Landmark
